title: My cat loves this!
text: I didn't realize that my cat even cared about toys since he only ever played with one dog toy in the house.  However, through buying these monthly boxes, I see that there are some toys he absolutely loves and others he could care less about.  I gifted the ones he didn't like to a friend who told me about how much her cat loved some of them.  So, I guess all cats have their preferences.  I keep digging his favorite toys out from underneath the fridge and stove and give the ones he doesn't care about to other cat owners hoping they will find a happy home.  While I've stopped my subscriptions for a time, I fully intend to subscribe again in the future.
label: positive
